subject: th-cont
title: TH.CONT.------AF.COMP.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 265 (PR.S(RD)II-19). TH-CONT (thrust continuance) is the subject; AF-COMP (affinity compression) is the partner. From the subject: SG (source initiation), PRI-INFO (principle information) and EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). From SG: COS-P (cosmic particulars). From PRI-INFO: INFO-DY (information dynamics). From EXP-DY: EXP-CONT (expansion condition). From COS-P: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From INFO-DY: APL-DT (application dictates), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
